top_signals.title: Trump offers U.S. help after plague death in Russia; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
top_signals.summary: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after a laboratory worker died following an illness at a plague research institute in Siberia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
